Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)


Reconstruction procedure:
Before writing the program, give a short visible-image specification: the main object
silhouettes and their approximate normalized image bounds (origin top-left), major
wall/floor boundaries, perspective directions, foreground cropping, and occlusion order.
These are estimates from RGB, not measured calibration. Choose camera position, target
and lens together to explain those observations. Put camera and major dimensions in
clearly named parameters. Build all major visible objects in the first program; defer
subpixel ornament until framing and large color regions agree. Preserve real 3D meshes
and meaningful multipart Asset groups throughout revisions.

Implementation facts to check before every execution:
- fillet_box requires 0 < radius <= half the smallest size component, including thickness.
  For a thin object, use an appropriately small radius or a different valid construction.
- realize clears Blender, including the world. After realize, obtain bpy.context.scene;
  if its world is None, assign bpy.data.worlds.new('World') before accessing world fields.
  Set world.use_nodes=True before accessing its Background shader.
- include replaces an existing child with the same key. Give repeated parts unique keys
  within their parent, including every loop index, so earlier geometry is retained.
- Use keyword arguments for rod endpoints. Every dimension must be positive and finite;
  consecutive sweep points and rod endpoints must be distinct.
- Transform pivots default to the object's bounding-box center. Specify pivot explicitly
  when rotating an assembly about a different point.
- SceneAct include keys name parent markers; generated mesh names may remain Box or Rod.
  For material edits, traverse the intended marker's mesh descendants, or retain explicit
  references, instead of assuming its include key is the mesh name. Copy shared materials
  before changing only one object's appearance.
- Create camera, lights, world and Blender material customization after realize. Keep
  the supplied image aspect ratio. Do not change fixed runner limits or render settings
  to obtain extra renders. Never call rendering, saving, external tools or file inspection.

After a successful render, compare the reference and render explicitly. Identify at most
three high-impact discrepancies, stating the affected image region and the proposed
parameter change. Prioritize camera/framing, silhouette/occlusion, and broad color/light
regions before fine detail. A global displacement suggests camera aim/shift; wrong
perspective slopes suggest orientation; wrong near/far size ratios suggest camera
position and focal length; a local mismatch suggests object geometry or placement.
Avoid changing camera and many unrelated object dimensions without a stated reason.
Return a complete standalone program for each revision, never a patch.
Missing output is a failed attempt, not an image to critique. Fix the reported error and
check the entire program for related errors before retrying. Do not invent render metrics.

The harness may request a source audit before the first execution. This is a model-only
review, not permission to run code. When asked to choose among successful renders, reply
SELECT <step> using a supplied step number. Choose by reference agreement, not recency.
DONE accepts the latest successful build. A selection is only valid for a successful
execution with an available rendered image.

The island occupies roughly (0.33, 0.55)–(0.90, 0.85), with a plain near end and three drawers along its right-facing side. A tall cream extractor hangs above it at (0.42, 0.04)–(0.73, 0.44). Dark cabinetry fills the rear wall, while a timber post crosses the foreground at x≈0.17–0.31. Pale tiled flooring meets the cabinetry around y≈0.73; exposed black ceiling beams frame the top. The camera looks diagonally along the island, with the foreground post occluding the left kitchen units.

```python
from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math
import random

# Major dimensions and camera
ISLAND_WIDTH = 1.05
ISLAND_LENGTH = 2.20
COUNTER_HEIGHT = 0.91
ROOM_HEIGHT = 3.45
CAMERA_POSITION = (4.15, -6.5, 2.95)
CAMERA_TARGET = (0.0, 0.05, 1.65)
CAMERA_LENS = 42

scene = Scene("Modern kitchen")
cream = (0.65, 0.66, 0.62)
counter = (0.79, 0.80, 0.74)
charcoal = (0.055, 0.062, 0.060)
black = (0.022, 0.027, 0.026)
steel = (0.36, 0.39, 0.38)

def add_box(parent, name, size, center, color):
    parent.include(name, box(size=size, center=center, color=color))

# Room shell
room = Asset("Room")
add_box(room, "floor", (12, 12, .12), (0, 0, -.07), (.63, .62, .57))
add_box(room, "back_wall", (7.5, .16, ROOM_HEIGHT),
        (0, 2.05, ROOM_HEIGHT / 2), (.36, .37, .34))
add_box(room, "left_wall", (.16, 6.5, ROOM_HEIGHT),
        (-2.85, .3, ROOM_HEIGHT / 2), (.40, .41, .37))
add_box(room, "ceiling", (9, 9, .13),
        (0, 0, ROOM_HEIGHT + .065), (.040, .047, .044))
scene.include("room", room)

# Large porcelain floor tiles, with fine seams
tiles = Asset("Floor tiling")
for i in range(-6, 7):
    for j in range(-7, 7):
        add_box(tiles, f"tile_{i}_{j}", (.895, .895, .012),
                (i * .90, j * .90, -.004),
                (.67 + .008 * ((i+j) % 3), .66 + .008 * ((i+j) % 3),
                 .61 + .008 * ((i+j) % 3)))
scene.include("tiles", tiles)

# Rear kitchen: tall cupboard at left, recessed worktop, oven tower at right
kitchen = Asset("Rear kitchen")
add_box(kitchen, "tall_left", (.77, .68, 2.28),
        (-1.91, 1.58, 1.14), charcoal)
add_box(kitchen, "tall_left_front", (.755, .025, 2.24),
        (-1.91, 1.225, 1.14), (.067, .074, .070))
add_box(kitchen, "left_upper_seam", (.75, .008, .009),
        (-1.91, 1.208, 1.99), black)
add_box(kitchen, "base_run", (2.25, .63, .83),
        (-.41, 1.60, .415), (.043, .049, .046))
add_box(kitchen, "back_counter", (2.30, .70, .045),
        (-.41, 1.55, .855), (.18, .19, .17))
for i in range(4):
    x = -1.24 + .55 * i
    add_box(kitchen, f"base_door_{i}", (.54, .022, .75),
            (x, 1.273, .44), (.055, .061, .057))
add_box(kitchen, "backsplash", (2.33, .035, .67),
        (-.39, 1.94, 1.22), (.065, .074, .066))
for i in range(5):
    add_box(kitchen, f"backsplash_joint_{i}", (.008, .012, .64),
            (-1.52 + i * .49, 1.914, 1.22), (.035, .042, .037))
add_box(kitchen, "upper_cabinets", (2.40, .48, .69),
        (-.45, 1.78, 1.91), (.057, .064, .059))
for i in range(4):
    add_box(kitchen, f"upper_panel_{i}", (.59, .025, .675),
            (-1.35 + i * .60, 1.528, 1.91), (.069, .076, .068))
add_box(kitchen, "under_cabinet_light", (2.20, .025, .018),
        (-.42, 1.53, 1.558), (.90, .76, .59))
add_box(kitchen, "oven_tower", (.76, .71, 2.11),
        (1.19, 1.64, 1.055), (.045, .052, .048))
add_box(kitchen, "oven_tower_side", (.045, .76, 2.15),
        (1.59, 1.64, 1.075), (.065, .071, .065))
for n, z in enumerate((.80, 1.39)):
    add_box(kitchen, f"oven_frame_{n}", (.625, .035, .52),
            (1.19, 1.265, z), (.23, .25, .24))
    add_box(kitchen, f"oven_glass_{n}", (.535, .018, .35),
            (1.19, 1.238, z-.015), (.023, .037, .040))
    add_box(kitchen, f"oven_controls_{n}", (.60, .025, .08),
            (1.19, 1.232, z+.215), (.29, .31, .29))
    add_box(kitchen, f"oven_handle_{n}", (.48, .045, .024),
            (1.19, 1.20, z+.125), (.47, .49, .46))
add_box(kitchen, "right_tall_dark_panel", (.70, .72, 2.35),
        (1.97, 1.65, 1.175), (.041, .048, .044))
add_box(kitchen, "rear_bulkhead", (4.8, .64, .34),
        (-.25, 1.76, 2.54), (.30, .32, .29))
scene.include("kitchen", kitchen)

# Island with a thick, very pale slab and handleless drawers on the visible side
island = Asset("Island")
add_box(island, "body", (ISLAND_WIDTH, ISLAND_LENGTH, .805),
        (0, -.12, .4675), cream)
add_box(island, "recessed_plinth", (.94, 2.10, .10),
        (-.015, -.12, .065), (.24, .25, .23))
add_box(island, "countertop", (1.095, 2.25, .045),
        (0, -.12, .895), counter)
add_box(island, "plain_end", (1.055, .025, .825),
        (0, -1.233, .455), (.58, .60, .57))
# Side x positive is the long drawer face.
for i, z in enumerate((.225, .478, .725)):
    add_box(island, f"drawer_{i}", (.024, 2.155, .232),
            (.537, -.105, z), (.66, .68, .64))
    add_box(island, f"drawer_reveal_{i}", (.012, 2.16, .014),
            (.542, -.105, z+.122), (.24, .26, .24))
scene.include("island", island)

# Flush sink and polished arched faucet near the far end
sink = Asset("Sink and faucet")
add_box(sink, "sink_rim", (.49, .48, .008),
        (.025, .43, .921), (.59, .63, .60))
add_box(sink, "sink_basin", (.435, .425, .009),
        (.025, .43, .926), (.43, .48, .45))
add_box(sink, "sink_inner", (.365, .34, .01),
        (.025, .43, .931), (.54, .58, .54))
sink.include("tap", sweep_tube(
    points=[(-.23,.66,.925),(-.23,.66,1.12),(-.23,.64,1.17),
            (-.23,.57,1.19),(-.23,.48,1.19),(-.23,.44,1.16),
            (-.23,.44,1.10)],
    radius=.013, color=(.63,.67,.65)))
sink.include("tap_base", rod(radius=.025, length=.025,
                             center=(-.23,.66,.937), color=steel))
sink.include("lever", rod(radius=.008, start=(-.20,.66,.95),
                          end=(-.16,.66,1.025), color=steel))
scene.include("sink", sink)

# Suspended rectangular extractor: tall, monolithic plaster-like housing
hood = Asset("Extractor")
HOOD_BOTTOM = 1.98
HOOD_TOP = 3.43
add_box(hood, "housing", (.79, 1.12, HOOD_TOP-HOOD_BOTTOM),
        (-.025, -.08, (HOOD_TOP+HOOD_BOTTOM)/2), (.75, .75, .68))
add_box(hood, "underside", (.765, 1.095, .018),
        (-.025, -.08, HOOD_BOTTOM), (.52, .53, .47))
add_box(hood, "filter", (.53, .67, .008),
        (-.025, -.08, HOOD_BOTTOM-.011), (.32, .34, .30))
for x in (-.26, .21):
    add_box(hood, f"lamp_{x}", (.045, .045, .009),
            (x, -.38, HOOD_BOTTOM-.012), (.88, .86, .71))
scene.include("extractor", hood)

# Red kettle on the back counter
kettle = Asset("Red kettle")
kettle.include("red_body", ball(radius=.098, center=(-.58,1.52,.963),
                                color=(.62,.008,.018)))
add_box(kettle, "black_foot", (.15,.14,.028),
        (-.58,1.52,.884), (.018,.021,.020))
kettle.include("handle", sweep_tube(
    points=[(-.65,1.52,.96),(-.68,1.52,1.045),(-.65,1.52,1.085),
            (-.55,1.52,1.085),(-.52,1.52,1.025)],
    radius=.013, color=(.012,.015,.014)))
add_box(kettle, "lid", (.09,.09,.018),
        (-.58,1.52,1.052), (.025,.028,.026))
scene.include("kettle", kettle)

# Timber columns, one very close to the camera and cropped at the top
posts = Asset("Timber structure")
POST_CENTER = (-1.20, -2.05)
add_box(posts, "foreground_post", (.29,.31,3.85),
        (POST_CENTER[0],POST_CENTER[1],1.925), (.38,.235,.12))
add_box(posts, "right_post", (.15,.16,3.35),
        (2.52,1.72,1.675), (.48,.31,.17))
scene.include("posts", posts)

# Exposed black ceiling ribs, beams and service runs
ceiling = Asset("Exposed ceiling")
for i in range(10):
    x = -3.4 + i*.66
    add_box(ceiling, f"joist_{i}", (.085,7.5,.18),
            (x,.1,3.32), (.031,.038,.035))
for i, y in enumerate((-2.1,-.2,1.65)):
    add_box(ceiling, f"cross_beam_{i}", (7.7,.20,.29),
            (0,y,3.20), (.045,.053,.049))
add_box(ceiling, "large_diagonal_perspective_beam", (.26,7.6,.31),
        (1.60,.2,3.15), (.07,.079,.073))
ceiling.include("service_pipe", rod(radius=.027,
    start=(-2.2,1.15,3.10),end=(2.7,1.15,3.10),
    color=(.12,.14,.13)))
scene.include("ceiling_structure", ceiling)

realize(scene)

# Material customization on actual mesh descendants
def meshes_below(obj):
    if obj.type == 'MESH':
        yield obj
    for child in obj.children:
        yield from meshes_below(child)

# Procedural wood grain and subtle plaster/stone surface variation
for obj in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    for slot in obj.material_slots:
        if slot.material:
            mat = slot.material
            mat.use_nodes = True
            bs = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
            if bs:
                bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .52

for marker_name in ("foreground_post", "right_post"):
    markers = [o for o in bpy.data.objects
               if o.name == marker_name or o.name.endswith("/"+marker_name)]
    # SceneAct marker names may be prefixed; locate by substring as well.
    if not markers:
        markers = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if marker_name in o.name]
    for marker in markers:
        for obj in meshes_below(marker):
            mat = bpy.data.materials.new("Natural longitudinal timber")
            mat.use_nodes = True
            nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
            links = mat.node_tree.links
            bs = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
            bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .69
            tex = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
            tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 4
            tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3
            coords = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
            mapping = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
            mapping.operation = 'MULTIPLY'
            mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (8,8,.32)
            links.new(coords.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
            links.new(mapping.outputs[0],tex.inputs["Vector"])
            ramp = nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .22
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (.16,.075,.028,1)
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .79
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (.52,.34,.18,1)
            links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
            links.new(ramp.outputs[0],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
            bump = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
            bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = .17
            bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = .012
            links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
            links.new(bump.outputs[0],bs.inputs["Normal"])
            obj.data.materials.clear()
            obj.data.materials.append(mat)

set_view(position=CAMERA_POSITION, target=CAMERA_TARGET,
         lens=CAMERA_LENS, sensor=36)

area_emitter((.7,-3.5,3.1), power=650, size=4.0,
             target=(0,0,.5), color=(1.0,.96,.87))
area_emitter((-2.0,-.8,2.8), power=350, size=2.4,
             target=(0,.6,1.1), color=(1.0,.97,.89))
area_emitter((2.8,.7,2.9), power=230, size=2.2,
             target=(0,0,1), color=(.88,.93,1.0))
area_emitter((-.5,1.45,1.53), power=32, size=1.4,
             target=(-.5,1.45,.85), color=(1.0,.76,.56))

bs = bpy.context.scene
if bs.world is None:
    bs.world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
bs.world.use_nodes = True
bs.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Color"].default_value = (.23,.25,.23,1)
bs.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Strength"].default_value = .24
bs.view_settings.view_transform = 'AgX'
```
